question: Does explicit observed-versus-anchor selection remove length-sensitive historical feature changes, and what frozen-model inference changes?
selection: One valid observed row per date takes priority over a synthetic anchor; anchor takes priority over invalid observation; duplicate rows of same kind rejected. Anchor known_at is first observed calendar day of following target month. Never treat anchor as observed price/coverage.
blocks: Continuous segment identifier is segment start YYYYMMDD, not ordinal sensitive to inserted earlier isolated anchors.
preserve: R128 matrices, economic membership/coverage/precision unchanged; original sources and research outputs remain untouched. New version only.
gates: Shared observations and ready features must be invariant between successive cutoffs. Historical inserts allowed only documented anchors with known_at after prior cutoff. Compare all columns/input eligibility with old version.
inference: Fixed R02/R16 models and full current catalog; evaluate latest completed date plus every historical month with changed ready-feature population or values. No training or label refresh in this round; retraining impact remains separate.
quality: Historical-proxy local replay; source vintages unchanged, no predictive increment claim.
